experimental_logic.physical_execution: Cells may execute serially on one GPU.
experimental_logic.scientific_execution: Treat all cells as one sealed pre-frozen batch.
experimental_logic.forbidden_adaptation: No intermediate result may change later cells, ordering, panels, thresholds, exclusions, retry rules, stopping rules, or analysis.
experimental_logic.decision_time: Apply the frozen gates once after the complete valid batch is available.
experimental_logic.single_positive_result_boundary: A positive development result can retain only the narrow target-interface hypothesis; it cannot establish a general causal mechanism.

existing_evidence.claim: The old uniform shared-latent-result-identity mechanism failed the frozen R10 model-free diagnostic on all four M0 stacks.
existing_evidence.inference_boundary: This rejects that frozen mechanism; it does not prove the target-interface competitor.

evidence_partition.reasonable_inference: The exact R10 M0/M1 split makes target codebook or verifier-surface alignment a plausible development hypothesis worth a controlled screen.
evidence_partition.unverified_core_hypothesis: For the four frozen outcome-aware M0 affine stacks, the pre-to-post target wrong-vs-gold log-odds effect of one fixed source-only update depends on the target codebook interface.
evidence_partition.not_yet_observed: No R13 tokenizer load, model load, forward pass, gradient, optimizer step, raw result, or scientific result exists.

r13_design.matched_design: Execute each source BUG update once and reuse the exact same post-update parameter hash for H0 and H1 target readout panels; H0 and H1 differ only in the frozen target codebook interface.
r13_design.raw_effect: E(k,s,h,r,q)=[post log P_h(z+q)-post log P_h(z)]-[pre log P_h(z+q)-pre log P_h(z)]
r13_design.technical_reproducibility: A/B reversed process order is a technical check, not an independent scientific replicate.
r13_design.scope: Four fixed outcome-aware M0 affine development stacks in two task-pair clusters.

absolute_effect_addendum.joint_directional_gate: The parent relative interface-switch gate and A_aligned_stack(s)>1e-10 must both pass in all four stacks.
absolute_effect_addendum.interpretation_guard: If the relative interface effect is positive but A_aligned_stack(s)<=0, label RELATIVE_PRESERVATION_ONLY_NOT_ABSOLUTE_AMPLIFICATION.
absolute_effect_addendum.dead_zone_guard: If 0<A_aligned_stack(s)<=1e-10, do not call it amplification.

gpt_pro_advisory_review.authorization_boundary: GPT PRO reviews are advisory and cannot authorize model execution.
